description: This file defines the EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware class responsible for handling endpoint discovery logic within the AWS SDK for PHP. It manages caching, endpoint retrieval, request modification, and error handling related to dynamic endpoint endpoints for AWS services.

classes.name: EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class in AWS SDK that manages endpoint discovery, including caching, endpoint resolution, request modification, and error handling for AWS service operations.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: A static method to wrap a handler with endpoint discovery functionality, returning a new instance of EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the middleware with the handler, client, arguments, and configuration.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main invocation method that executes the middleware logic, handling endpoint discovery and request modification.

methods.name: discoverEndpoint
methods.description: Performs endpoint discovery by executing a dedicated discovery command and updating cache.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on credentials, command, and identifiers.

methods.name: getDiscoveryCommand
methods.description: Builds the command used to discover endpoints based on the operation and identifiers.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Extracts endpoint discovery identifiers from the operation's input shape.

methods.name: handleDiscoveryException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during endpoint discovery, throwing or falling back based on necessity.

methods.name: handleInvalidEndpoint
methods.description: Handles situations where an endpoint is invalid, attempting to recover or re-discover endpoints.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request URI and headers based on the discovered endpoint.

methods.name: parseEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a URL string into host and path components usable for request modification.

methods.name: useOriginalUri
methods.description: Reverts to the original URI when endpoint discovery cannot resolve a new endpoint.
